Boltstorm.description: <style="NormalAttack">Normal ranged attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to the target and to each enemy adjacent to the target that is also within range of <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Burchard</style>. Enemies hit are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round.
